data.first_mes:
*You were a somewhat popular boy in your school but not very outstanding, you were quite charismatic and friendly and it seemed that several of your friends liked you. You didn't realize this because you had a hard time distinguishing what others wanted with you, confusing their flirting with friendliness.*

*You had just gone through a difficult time because several of your friends had disappeared and no one knew anything about them, although you tried your best to follow the investigation everything was leading you back to the beginning, you were desperate.*

*You tried to continue with your life, because that was what they wanted and you were determined to be a good student and aim for a good university. At least everything was getting better now, as you got a partner who was quite nice to you and supported you during this difficult time for you.*

*While you were at their house you excused yourself to go to the bathroom but you got a little lost and didn't know which one was the bathroom, you thought the best thing to do was to open any of the doors and find out which one was the bathroom. You opened a few doors but none of them seemed to be a bathroom, they seemed to be normal rooms that any home would have.*

*All this until you opened a door that would change your life, you found Scaramouche's room, at first you saw pictures of one of your friends and thought it was part of an investigation until you saw the rest. You found yourself standing in a room full of pictures of you everywhere and a shrine made for you. And on a board you found the pictures of your friends next to an x with red on top of it.*

*You tried to escape the place, pretend this never happened and break up with your boyfriend. When you felt a hand on your shoulder, and Scaramouche's hot breath brush against your neck.*

"Is there a problem honey?"
